opacity.description:
Glass opacity multiplier (None = 1): 0.55 更透明, 1.6 更厚实, 0 全透明 — no plate at all
until the pointer is over the fence.

shrinkCollapsed.description:
Collapsed, the title bar shrinks to its title or tabs instead of keeping the fence's
length (None = only a column on a side does).

sideTabText.description: How a title column on a side shows two or more tabs.

tabRgb.description: This fence's bar in a tab strip (None = its tint).

tintRgb.description: Colour wash over the glass (Fences per-fence colour).

tintTitleOnly.description: The tint washes only the title row instead of the whole glass.

titleAlign.description: Where the title sits in its row (None = the global `titleAlign`).

titleEdge.description: The edge the title bar runs along (Title bar position).

titleOnHover.description:
The title row folds away until the pointer is over the fence (None = the global
`rollUp.titleOnHover`).

titleRgb.description: Title text colour (None = theme text colour).

oneOf.description: One material for all fences. Older configurations and snapshots still load.
Shortcut-target rules always evaluate first (Stardock 4.07 behaviour).

A file that is not a program, a shortcut or a shell namespace item (This PC, Recycle
Bin): last in the list, it takes every file the earlier rules left. `config.json` saves
it as `{"cond":"filesOnly","plain":true}`, which versions without it read as `filesOnly`.
Minutes since midnight, local time; wraps past midnight when `from > to`.
0 = Monday … 6 = Sunday.

Days since the item was last written or last opened from a fence, whichever is later,
is at least `min`. Never matches when the age is unknown.

ExpandDirection.description: Which way a fence opens from its rolled title row (Expand direction).

oneOf.description: Away from the title bar, which stays put.
Keeps the top edge (a title bar at the top or bottom).

Keeps the bottom edge (a title bar at the top or bottom), for a fence near the bottom of
the screen.
Keeps the right edge (a title bar on a side).
Keeps the left edge (a title bar on a side).

activeTab.description: On a host: which tab's items the window shows (`None` = the host's own).

expandDirection.description:
The edge the fence keeps when it rolls up and expands. `geometry` holds the expanded
rectangle either way.

hideTitleIcon.description: Folder portal: hide the folder glyph before the title.

hideWhenEmpty.description:
Inbox: no window while it holds no items (为空时自动隐藏); the next item to land on the
desktop brings it back at its saved spot.

locked.description: Position and size cannot be changed with the mouse (Fences "锁定").

openFoldersInside.description:
Any other fence: double-clicking a folder, or a shortcut to a folder, shows that folder
inside the fence until the fence goes up from it; off (the default) = open it in Explorer.

portalNavigate.description:
Folder portal: double-clicking a subfolder opens it inside the portal (Fences
"Navigate"); off = open it in Explorer.

tabHost.description:
Shown as a tab inside another fence's window (Fences 6 tabbed fences). A hosted fence has
no window of its own; its geometry is kept for when it is split out again.

tabOrder.description:
On a host: strip order of its tabs (may place the host itself anywhere). Ids that are no
longer tabs are ignored; tabs missing here are appended in layout order.

oneOf.description: The system "桌面" fence that receives everything unassigned. Exactly one per layout.

columnWidths.description: Details view column widths (修改日期, 类型, 大小) in DIPs; None = defaults.

columnsVisible.description: Details columns shown (修改日期, 类型, 大小); None = all.

groupByDate.description:
"按时间分组": items under 今天 / 昨天 / 本周 / 本月 / 更早 section headers (all
layouts). Implies `sort == Date`.

oneOf.description: Icon shared by extension (documents, most files).
Icon specific to this file (.exe, .lnk, .ico, folders with custom icons, images).

chameleon.description: Chameleon: icons desaturate and fade so they blend with the backdrop.

shortcutArrows.description: Windows' shortcut arrow at the bottom-left of the items Explorer draws it on.

tintRgb.description: Colourise every icon toward this colour.

lastOpened.description: Unix seconds of the last launch from a fence (the "闲置天数" rule condition).

openCount.description: How often the item was launched from a fence ("按打开次数" sorting).

path.description:
The path as spelled on disk (`ABC.zip`); `key` is its case-folded form for matching.
Missing in older files until the next desktop sync.

size.description: File size in bytes (0 for folders); used by "按大小" sorting.

oneOf.description: Lower-cased, normalized absolute path.
Base64 PIDL for namespace items (later).

LabelColor.description:
Item name colour (「图标名称颜色」). Auto: Liquid Glass picks dark or light text from the
wallpaper under each fence, Fluent follows the colour mode. The halo pairs with the text.

Layout.description:
Where the fences sit on one set of monitors. Every set shows the same fences (titles,
items, tabs, views): the layout shown last holds them as they are, and showing another
layout carries them over, keeping that layout's geometry and roll state for each fence it
had.

fingerprint.description:
Monitor identities; the layout applies when they are the connected monitors (each found
by id, model or GDI name).

shown.description:
Raised each time the layout is shown; the highest one is the layout shown last. 0 in
files from 0.1.3 and earlier, which kept separate fences per monitor set.

devicePath.description:
The monitor's id: its device instance (`GSM7787#5&2C948443&0&UID24832`), else its EDID
model and connector (`GSM7787#5.0`), else `\\.\DISPLAYn` (all that files from 0.1.3 and
earlier have).

screenPx.description:
Resolution in physical px (taskbar included). With `dpi` it is part of the set: the
same monitors at another resolution or scale have a layout of their own. `[0, 0]` in
layouts saved before that; such a layout takes the resolution it is next shown at.

workDip.description: Work-area size in DIPs at save time.

NormGeometry.description: Fence geometry relative to a monitor's work area, in DIPs (plan §7.4).

PeekHotkey.description:
The shortcuts versions up to 0.2.0 offered. Fences uses Win+Space, but Windows 10 and 11
keep Win+Space and Win+Shift+Space for the input switcher even with a single keyboard
layout, so a file that names one of them loads with Ctrl+Alt+Space (`config_store::migrate`).

customHotkey.description:
Any other shortcut, as text such as `"Ctrl+Shift+F"` or `"Win+Alt+Space"`: modifiers
(Win, Ctrl, Alt, Shift; Ctrl, Alt or Win needed) and a letter, digit, F1 to F24, Num0 to
Num9, Space, Enter, Tab, Esc, Backspace, Insert, Delete, Home, End, PageUp, PageDown or
an arrow key (Left, Up, Right, Down). `null` = use `hotkey`. Text that is not a usable
shortcut is ignored the same way.

dim.description: Dim everything behind the fences while peeking.

hotkey.description: The shortcut as versions up to 0.2.0 store it; `customHotkey` replaces it when set.

clickToExpand.description:
A rolled fence expands on a single title click instead of on hover (Fences "require a
click to expand"). Hover peek is ignored while this is on.

hideCountAndChevron.description:
No item count on a rolled title and no roll chevron: the title bar shows the name only.
Double-clicking the title and the fence menu still roll the fence up and down.

hideInactiveScrollbar.description: Show the scrollbar only while the mouse is inside the fence or right after scrolling.

pushNeighbors.description:
While a fence is expanded (a click or a hover peek), the fences stacked below it slide down
out of its way and slide back when it rolls up. The saved positions stay where they were.

switchTabOnHover.description:
Resting the pointer on a tab of a tabbed fence for the hover delay switches to it, as a
click would.

titleOnHover.description:
Draw the title (and tabs) only while the mouse is over the fence; a fence's
`appearance.titleOnHover` overrides it.

template.description:
The "快速添加" template this rule came from (see [`Template::key`]), so the template
is offered once even after the user renames the rule.

list.description: Ordered; the first matching rule wins (after class ordering).

unmatched.description: Where applying the rules puts an item already in a fence that no rule matches.

customTheme.description:
A theme file in the configuration's `themes` folder, by name without `.json`. While it
loads, its `base` takes the place of `themeStyle`.

desktopPath.description:
The user's Desktop folder as last seen, so a moved desktop (OneDrive, another drive) can
have its item records re-pointed instead of orphaned.

hideInboxWhenIconsShown.description:
While `hideRealIcons` is off, the inbox fence has no window: the items no rule files
show only among Windows' own desktop icons.

keepIconsHidden.description:
With `hideRealIcons`, Windows' desktop icons stay hidden when PecoFence exits or the
session ends, so they do not show for a moment at the next sign-in before PecoFence
starts. A crash still shows them.

labelColor.description: Colour of the item names in every fence; fence titles have their own `titleColor`.

offerNewFence.description: A rectangle drawn on the empty desktop that touches no fence offers 「在此新建栅栏」.

peek.description: Fences "Peek": a hotkey floats every fence above the current windows.

themeStyle.description: Material style is independent of the light/dark preference.

titleAlign.description:
Where every fence's title (or tab strip) sits in its title row, unless the fence's
`appearance.titleAlign` says otherwise.

SideTabText.description: How a title column on a side shows two or more tabs (Tab text on a side).

oneOf.description: The captions turn to read downwards, in a strip as narrow as a title row is tall.
The captions read across, one tab per row in a wider column.

enabled.description:
Dragged fences snap to other fences, the screen edges and the screen's centre lines
(Alt held: free).

gapPx.description: Gap, in DIPs, fences keep to each other and the screen edges while snapping.

guideLines.description:
While snapping, guide lines along the edges a dragged or resized fence lines up with
and the screen centre lines it snapped to.

sizeToCells.description: Resizing keeps whole icon columns and rows.

Snapshot.description: A named copy of every layout (fence geometry, membership, view flags) taken at `ts`.

oneOf.description: Most-opened first (launch count kept per item).

Spacing.description: Distance between icons in the grid (Fences "icon spacing").

TitleAlign.description:
Title position in the title row (Fences centres it). The chevron zone on the right stays
clear whichever is chosen. Down a title column on a side, left is the top and right the
bottom.

TitleEdge.description:
The edge of a fence its title bar runs along (Title bar position). A title bar on a side is a
column, where the title and tabs turn to read downwards (the tabs can read across instead,
see [`SideTabText`]).

oneOf.description:
Setup packages: `.msi`/`.msix`/`.appx` families and `.exe` files whose name says
setup/install. Listed after `Programs` in the enum but matched first when a rule using
it precedes the Programs rule (first match wins).

Unmatched.description:
What applying the rules does with an item no rule matches. A new item, in no fence yet,
always goes to the default target.

oneOf.description: Back to the default target (the 「桌面」 fence).
It stays in the fence it is in.

ViewLayout.description: How a fence lays out its items (Fences 6 "view style").

oneOf.description: Icon grid with labels underneath.
Compact rows: small icon + name.
Rows with sortable columns: 名称 / 修改日期 / 类型 / 大小.

$schema.description:
`$schema`: URL of the JSON Schema this file follows ([`CONFIG_SCHEMA_URL`]); informative
only, the app ignores its value.

items.description: Global item table keyed by id.

snapshots.description: Saved layouts the user can return to (Fences "snapshots").
